name: Mujintou Survivors
source:
Everyone has been looking to the school boat trip, including Aina and her best friend Ikuya.
However, the boat gets in an accident, and the two end up washing ashore on a remote island.
Aina is happy to see the protagonist is fine, and the two decide to wait for help.
While exploring the island, they meet four other guys who've washed up.
1 woman. 5 men.
Aina has a bad feeling about this situation...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ341761.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
每个人都期待着学校乘船旅行，包括爱娜和她最好的朋友郁也。
然而，船发生了事故，两人最终被冲到了一个偏远的岛屿上。
看到主角没事，艾娜很高兴，两人决定等待救援。
在探索岛屿时，他们遇到了另外四个被冲上岸的人。
1名女性。5个人。
爱娜有种不好的预感……
